note: Reviewed labels for the synthetic evaluation set. These are the outcomes a human reviewer recorded for each derived case, written from the fixture intent BEFORE the engine was run against them. NO RUNTIME AGENT MAY READ THIS FILE: it exists for the evaluation report and for the precedent activation gate only. A test asserts that nothing under src/agents or src/providers imports it.

labels.rationale: Six-metre accuracy places the vehicle inside the 50 m radius, sampling continuity holds, the wait exceeded the threshold and contact was attempted.
The driver's stationary fixes are hundreds of metres from the pickup point, so the vehicle was never inside the zone and the no-show fee is not supported.
Without an accuracy radius the pickup-zone rule cannot classify the sample, so no automatic outcome is available.
The governing waiting clock is undefined and the choice of clock changes whether the threshold is met. This is a policy question, not a data gap.
The deviation was verified as rider-approved before it was taken, so no excess-route refund is owed.
The deviation is verified as unjustified and an eligible excess-route surcharge is identified, so the surcharge is refunded up to the disputed amount.
An explicit safety allegation is present, so the case routes to a human and is never resolved by the model, whatever the fare evidence shows.
The accuracy radius is absent from the case record and the simulated source holds no record, so the zone stays indeterminate.
